requirements.invariant: An authorized user reads one stable Account-scoped Space identity with exactly one immutable Project-or-Business-Inventory scope. Space placement is organizational only and this read cannot create or change accounting, Item placement or lifecycle state.

The exact Space record preserves accepted stored name and optional notes, active-or-archived lifecycle, a positive signed-bigint revision lifted losslessly into the Core UInt64 value, and finite millisecond-consistent record timestamps without claiming server-authored audit provenance or introducing writer-side normalization or byte-limit policy.

Checklist persistence is relational and preserves stable checklist identity/order plus stable item identity/order, exact text and checked state. Item identity is unique only within its owning checklist; zero checklists and zero-item checklists remain valid.

Completed and total counts are derived from the complete represented hierarchy. This slice stores no percentage, aggregate count or legacy isComplete authority and never presents incomplete child evidence as authoritative progress.

Reuse SWIFT-02BF0EA3C433 and TEST-377B0FDAF4D4 unchanged as the sole exact-Space request/snapshot/update/readiness/query authority. TQUERY-CD97754157F6 and TACCESS-281F2B9A29AB remain mapped with all six logical axes reviewed and no unresolved axis.

One exact-Space on-demand stream carries parent plus complete ordered checklist hierarchy for active or archived Space detail. The provider uses encrypted local rows offline and establishes completeness only from a fresh completion for that exact current-process stream.

AccountID and SpaceID subscription parameters only narrow signed identity plus active Account-membership authority. Revocation removes parent and child entitlement and local presentation; reactivation requires a new exact-stream completion.

One module-internal PowerSync adapter implements SpaceCoreDetailsQuerying. The public Account-workspace runtime binds Account implicitly and accepts one typed SpaceID; app model and view import Core contracts rather than provider, SQL, database or authorization types.

Every new exposed relation is forced-RLS and least-privilege; authenticated role alone is never authorization. The existing active-only Space destination policy is not broadened or combined with a permissive policy, and no SECURITY DEFINER or client mutation surface is added.

Preserve the seven existing spike_spaces columns, row bytes, Data API shape, grant, policy and streams; add only a redundant unique (account_id,id) parent key so every tenant child can enforce an exact same-Account composite foreign key. serverHandlers.notApplicable: No RPC, Edge Function, mutation handler, archive operation, checklist writer or trusted transaction is added; PowerSync reads the relational source directly.

items: Revoke all new core-detail and checklist-relation privileges from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated. Existing spike_spaces grants and seven-column Data API behavior remain byte-for-byte unchanged; no new core-detail, archived-detail or client mutation Data API surface is introduced.

Enable and force RLS on each new core-detail and checklist relation as defense in depth. Any policy is scoped by exact Account plus active membership and parent relationship; no role-only policy, user_metadata claim or permissive policy broadens the existing active-only spike_spaces SELECT behavior.

Anonymous, revoked, nonmember and cross-Account callers receive no relation privilege or row evidence. PowerSync stream authorization repeats signed active-membership checks for parent and every child rather than relying on client parameters or cached membership.

Add one on-demand space_core_details stream parameterized by exact AccountID and SpaceID, with separate relational queries for one base Space, its one-to-one core-detail row, all checklists and all checklist items. Every query joins signed auth identity to active Account membership and exact parent Account/Space; active and archived Spaces are included without filtering on owning-Project lifecycle.

The stream has no ordering, limit, list, Item, media, template, accounting, mutation or upload path. Local SQLite owns hierarchy ordering and Core validation. Existing active-only Space assignment streams remain unchanged.

One stream completion covers all four relation queries. The provider accepts completeness only after a fresh post-completion reread for the exact current process; revocation/selection loss clears rows and completeness immediately, and reactivation requires another exact completion.

Preserve the encrypted local Space table and add separate core-detail, checklist and checklist-item tables plus Account/Space/order indexes. One sentinel-preserving joined read returns membership plus zero-or-one base/detail pair and all child rows for atomic canonical reconstruction; a represented base without its detail row is malformed rather than authoritative absence.

Retained restart rows are partial or stale. Row and completeness sources each provide initial evidence in either order; every invalidation rereads the complete joined set, and only a reread causally after accepted exact-stream completion becomes complete.

The runtime owns one provider; selection replacement, consumer cancellation, membership loss and workspace close cancel/unsubscribe/join row and status observers before database close. Cross-Account, duplicate, malformed, overflow, invalid-order or orphan evidence fails atomically with bounded diagnostics.
